newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal seen leaving rates unchanged Friday - poll.
newsitem.headline: Portugal seen leaving rates unchanged Friday - poll.

text.p: Nine out of 10 analysts polled by Reuters on Thursday expect the Bank of Portugal to leave its key rates unchanged when it announces terms for the next commercial bank reserve period on Friday.

All 10 analysts believed the central bank would not cut its rate for draining funds, which stands at 5.80 percent, but one said the Bank might cut its injection rate, which it last fixed at 6.30 percent, by 10 basis points.
There was no demand for four-day funds today in a variable rate repo.
All the analysts contacted saw room for the Bank of Portugal to lower rates in the future.

The full names of the institutions taking part in the survey were: Banco Finantia, Banco Portugues de Investimento (BPI), Banco Mello de Investimentos (BMI), Banco de Comercio & Industria (BCI), Credit Lyonnais, IMF-Informacao de Mercados Financeiros, Siemca-Sociedade Mediadora de Capitais, Fincor.
